About Me

I am a Physics major in my third year of BSc Research program at the prestigious Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bangalore. I have demonstrated academic excellence with exceptional performance in CBSE board examinations and received a merit certificate for being among the top 0.1% of candidates nationwide in Computer Science.

I always had a hobby of exploring new technologies and tools, and after discovering the field of computational physics, I have developed a keen interest in programming and numerical simulations. I am seeking opportunities to apply my analytical abilities and technical knowledge in research projects and contribute to this field while learning from experienced researchers.
